introHtml: Brown awards recognition pieces bring a sense of warmth and natural sophistication to your employee appreciation programs. Whether you choose the rich wood tones of the Beech Star Award or the leather-like finish of a Cowhide Certificate Holder, brown works well for safety milestones, years of service, and leadership honors. Decorate with a gold or silver plate for a classic look that stands out in any office setting.
